topic: sub:12|Critical path analysis|Changing an activity’s duration

figures.cap: solution sketch: activity network annotated with earliest and latest start times

parts.latex: How many activities are on the critical path?
Determine the latest start time of activity E.
Which activity has the longest float time?

It is possible to reduce the completion time for activities C, D, G, H and K by employing more workers. The completion time for each of these activities can be reduced by a maximum of 2 weeks. What is the minimum time, in weeks, that the renovation project could take? Show working.

solutions.latex:
\exfigure{2846_q6_s1}

The critical path is
$$A - B - D - F - G - I - K - L$$
$$\therefore\ 8 \text{ activities}$$

The activity with the longest float is $J$.
$$\text{Float of } J = 5 \text{ weeks}$$

Reduce $D$ by $2$ and $C$ by $1$, saving $2$ weeks.

Reduce $G$ by $2$, $H$ by $1$ and $K$ by $2$, saving $4$ weeks.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Total saving} &= 6 \text{ weeks} \\ \text{Minimum time} &= 35 - 6 \\ &= 29 \text{ weeks} \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Finds either reduction, or equivalent merit
